scope.description: Complete P6 independent replay for the closed catalog, including LLM_BGZF and scientific conservation/decision checks, then publish only the VALIDATED_FROZEN_DATASET_GATE profile through a same-device atomic run-root transaction. Seven-dataset production deployment, producer pipeline implementation, M1/M2/solver changes, provenance and oracle authority are out of scope.

assumptions: The validator remains independently linked and must not link longlineage_core or include producer science/solver kernels.
The dataset gate is a bounded readiness profile: production_claim_allowed remains false even after successful validation and atomic freeze.

General query, evaluate and legacy-export entrypoints remain restricted to seven-dataset VALIDATED_FROZEN runs; a VALIDATED_FROZEN_DATASET_GATE run is readable only by a separate validated-only report/HTML gate and never masquerades as a production query root.

The producer receipt contract must expose producer_hostname, producer_kernel_release and per-input-role mount identity; mount metadata describes the environment and never substitutes for manifest/input SHA authority.
Schema catalog and id-registry edits, if required, are limited to synchronizing receipt schema digests; artifact membership and scientific producer contracts remain unchanged.

An indexed artifact may have zero logical rows; the canonical index file still exists and its zero-row physical bytes, semantic digest and empty reconstructed group set must match exactly, so an empty topology population never requires a fabricated abstain unit.
Any conservation or exact-test detail not derivable from frozen contracts and producer artifacts fails closed with a stable check identifier.

inputs.path: docs/audits/20260720_HCC1395完整執行與全資料推進閘門稽核_01.json

step_verify.step: Register the exact child lease and confirm non-overlap before implementation.
step_verify.verify: longlineage-governance check-state exits 0 and reports internally consistent non-overlapping active write sets.

step_verify.step: Replay every producer artifact and closeout artifact independently from the frozen catalog.
step_verify.verify: Synthetic complete positive fixture passes decompression, schema/header, physical/semantic SHA, row/key/order/index and closed membership checks for BGZF TSV/JSONL, plain TSV/JSON and LLM_BGZF; missing, extra, truncated, modified, reordered, duplicate and forged variants exit nonzero.

step_verify.step: Replay scientific conservation and selected statistical decisions without producer-kernel linkage.
step_verify.verify: Fault tests prove rejection of site/read/methyl/M1/cooccurrence/topology count drift, invalid 16-cell R/A/O/X partitions, global BH/BY drift, exact-test decision drift, incomplete topology v2 ranks and truth_fields_seen greater than zero.

step_verify.step: Publish the dataset-gate run root through the atomic state machine.
step_verify.verify: RUNNING to READY_FOR_VALIDATION to VALIDATED to atomic rename to FINAL_UNPUBLISHED to VALIDATED_FROZEN_DATASET_GATE is replayed; wrong digest and crash-after-rename cases remain query-invisible; final receipt has production_claim_allowed=false.

step_verify.step: Run the complete bounded P6 verification suite and inspect the built binary boundary.
step_verify.verify: Warnings-as-errors build, targeted and full CTest, schema/status/gate/source checks, link.txt/ldd and governance check-state exit 0; the executable contains no longlineage_core.

evidence.command: /usr/bin/cmake --build build-final-verify --target longlineage_validator test_validator_dataset_gate -j4; ctest --test-dir build-final-verify -R '^(validator_fault|validator_dataset_gate|run_root_transaction)$' --output-on-failure; bash scripts/ci/check_json_schema_fixtures.sh; bash scripts/ci/check_source_boundaries.sh; build-final-verify/bin/longlineage-governance check-{catalog,status-codes,state}
evidence.output_excerpt: Warnings-as-errors build passed; targeted P6 tests passed 3/3 in 6.36 s; schema, catalog, 118-code vocabulary, active lease and independent validator link boundaries passed. Synthetic DATASET_GATE only; production_claim_allowed=false.

deviations: The frozen catalog required four producer-owned run receipt draft fields and validator-owned final receipt fields; the receipt schemas and fail-closed checks were synchronized rather than allowing the producer to forge a final PASS.
The formal global exact family was narrowed to M2-screened ELIGIBLE_M2_EXACT_FAMILY rows. Descriptive exact p-values may exist for ineligible rows but never enter BH/BY or conditional confirmation.
An indexed zero-row topology artifact is canonical when its empty index bytes, zero row count, semantic digest and empty group replay agree; no synthetic abstain topology unit is fabricated.

The repository-wide full CTest run passed 35/36. The sole failure was the unrelated governance_agent_task_unknown_field_negative harness copying the parent active task without its newly added untracked audit evidence path; the parent owner accepted P6 science/boundary completion and will rerun full CTest after integration.

The repository publication repair later replaced private absolute-path strings in the receipt with portable tokens. The evidence SHA now binds that sanitized projection; validator counters and verdict fields were not changed.
